title: Brazil state-level Legal Reserve (Reserva Legal) ratios, Table F-1
description: Minimum Legal Reserve (Reserva Legal) share of rural property area by Brazilian state (GADM 4.1 GID_1) and Art. 12 native vegetation class (Law No. 12,651/2012). Legal Amazon rows follow the Forest Code's Art. 3, I definition (13°S parallel for Tocantins and Goiás), which differs from IBGE's Legal Amazon (LC 124/2007). Non-spatial lookup table; join to GADM 4.1 level-1 boundaries on gid_1 (or hasc_1). 1-4 rows per state; the vegetation class must come from vegetation physiognomy, not IBGE biomes. See README 'How to join' and 'Usage notes'.

table:columns.name: gid_1
table:columns.description: GADM 4.1 level-1 identifier (e.g. BRA.1_1). Primary join key (GADM field GID_1).

table:columns.name: hasc_1
table:columns.description: GADM 4.1 HASC_1 code (e.g. BR.AC). Secondary GADM join key; complete for all 27 states.

table:columns.name: gadm_version
table:columns.description: GADM release the gid_1 and hasc_1 codes refer to.

table:columns.name: ibge_cd_uf
table:columns.description: IBGE two-digit state code (CD_UF). Alternative join key; stored as text.

table:columns.name: art12_region
table:columns.description: Art. 12 region: legal_amazon (Art. 12, I) or rest_of_brazil (Art. 12, II). Legal Amazon follows Law 12,651/2012 Art. 3, I (13°S parallel for TO and GO).

table:columns.name: vegetation_class
table:columns.description: Art. 12 native vegetation class: forest, cerrado, campos_gerais, or all (rest of Brazil).

table:columns.name: vegetation_class_label
table:columns.description: Human-readable region and vegetation class as printed in Table F-1.

table:columns.name: legal_reserve_min_share
table:columns.description: Minimum Reserva Legal as a share (0-1) of rural property area.

table:columns.name: max_alt_land_use_share
table:columns.description: Maximum share (0-1) of rural property area eligible for alternative land use, before APP and other restrictions (= 1 - legal_reserve_min_share). Not a clearing entitlement.

table:columns.name: legal_basis
table:columns.description: Article of Law 12,651/2012 setting the percentage.
